commands.rationale: The Torus its owner handed over (QL's torus-native, kept by the kernel under the field's lease, Field::torus_native; the page names only its digest) sounds on one of the set's MIDI parts: the engine's node continues the owner's field from the sample it stood at, refused in words for a document that is not one, a part that plays no notes or a host built without QL's K8 node. From then on the part follows that owner (the kernel's tap, Field::set_torus_tap): each act the owner lands is struck at the owner's sample with the impulses the owner's law gave each mode, each later hand-over is taken in the last one's place, and the part's notes are the owner's: the host hands each clip note of the part over ahead of the engine, and each MIDI note sent to it at once, as the key the page's pitch→key law names for it (notes, O-I #853) at the owner's sample its frame falls on (the oi:live-engine-torus-notes event), which the page plays on the owner through the frame; the owner's act strikes the part back through the tap, and the Torus on the part strikes no note of its own. Its effects go with it (effects, the frame's own as its reading reports them): each on the frame's chain, in order, as Live's device of its kind on the chain after the Torus (Filter as Auto Filter, Dynamics as Compressor, Delay as Delay, Reverb as Reverb, as the shell's rackChainInLive places them), the engine's own device where it has one (live-engine rack_device) and said in words where it has none. The Live set's sound on the default output (live_engine_host.rs over packages/live-engine): a native audio presentation of the set its kernel owner keeps (live_set_owner.rs). It decides and writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine; Export Audio renders what you heard) and §21.2 (the torus is the only generator), O-I #849; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: The Torus's effects as the frame now holds them (effectsLaw.ts EffectsState, as its reading reports them) on the part following the Torus's owner: the frame's level first (its presentation gain, 0 to 4, live-engine LevelDevice, moved in place and gliding as the frame's gain glides), then each effect on the frame's chain, in order, as Live's device of its kind after the Torus (Filter as Auto Filter, Dynamics as Compressor, Delay as Delay, Reverb as Reverb, the shell's rackChainInLive mapping), the engine's own device for each (live-engine rack_device: Filter and Delay as the engine's models of Auto Filter and Delay, built to the frame's effects from Live's keys; Dynamics and Reverb as the frame runs them, its compressor and its room, from the frame's settings) and said in words where it does not sound as the frame's; each device made as before keeps its state, and Export Audio puts each chain there again at the frame the engine did. Refused in words for what is not the frame's effects and while no part follows the Torus. The Live set's sound on the default output (live_engine_host.rs over packages/live-engine): a native audio presentation of the set its kernel owner keeps (live_set_owner.rs). It decides and writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.

commands.rationale: Export Audio of a take through its part (O-I #855): the take's sound as the Torus's owner rendered it, sent raw by the page (oi.take-render/v1: a head naming the set's track, its rate and the Torus's effects at each frame, then its samples), laid where the Torus stands on its part in the set open in the engine (live-engine SampleInstrument) and rendered offline through the part's rack (the Torus's effects, each put at its frame as the engine puts them), its chain and its volume and pan, the part alone, its effects rung out past the take's end while they still sound (live-engine render_ringing_out, TAKE_RING_OUT: ended 5 s after the last frame above −96 dBFS, at the most 30 s); answered raw as a 32-bit float WAV's bytes, which the page saves. Refused in words for another rate than the engine's, a track that is no MIDI part, effects that are not the frame's and while no set is open in the engine. It decides and writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine; Export Audio renders what you heard) and §21.2 (What Export Audio renders is what you heard, sample for sample), O-I #855; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: Consolidate on an audio part (O-I #743): the host renders the part's clips alone across the stretch the page names, in beats (live-engine render_clips_alone: none of the part's chain or row), from the set as its owner reads it now, and hands the WAV's bytes to the kernel's Live owner, which keeps the sample beside the set and lays the clip that plays it (Kernel::live_audio_consolidate: a set the shell has read, against the set's revision and under the write gate, as every act on the set; live-set consolidate_audio), records its file_changed receipt and is answered with the clip, the sample and, in words, each clip of the stretch the engine did not play. Refused in words for what is not an audio part or a stretch of it, and for a set the shell has not read. The host writes no file. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine); Live 12 manual §10.9 (Consolidate), O-I #743; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: Crop on an audio clip (Live's Crop Clip, DLW build ruling 2026-11-05): the host cuts the stretch of the clip's sample its owner names (live-set crop_source: the clip's loop, or its start to its end, or the ruler's selection over it) from the file the clip plays, at the file's own rate and channels, and hands the WAV's bytes to the kernel's Live owner, which keeps the cut beside the set and crops the clip to play it (Kernel::live_audio_crop: a set the shell has read, against the set's revision and under the write gate, as every act on the set; live-set crop_audio), records its file_changed receipt and is answered with the clip and the sample. Refused in words for a MIDI clip, a clip with no sample file or region, a sample file that is gone or is no regular file (refused by live-set crop_source before anything is cut, as Reverse refuses them; 48e item 3), and a set the shell has not read. The host writes no file. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §10.9 (Clip: In Arrangement view, Split, Consolidate and Crop); Live Object Model Clip.crop (docs/research/ableton-live-12.0.25/lom/LOM-INVENTORY.md); docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: A row's take frozen on its part (O-I #849 round 22; DLW build ruling 2026-11-05: a true Torus per row player, through the engine, as Live's Freeze Track does): the take's sound as the Torus's owner rendered it, sent raw by the page (oi.take-render/v1 with the owner's sample it lands at and its name), rendered offline through the Torus's effects as they moved and the part's own chain (its mixer at unity: Freeze renders the chain), and laid on the part in the engine from the frame its landing falls on, playing in place of the part's chain until it ends, through the part's own volume, pan and sends; the host keeps the registry of the takes it froze, which Export Audio freezes again. Refused in words for a take with no landing, while the engine follows no Torus it has taken, for another rate than the engine's, a track that is no MIDI part, and while no set is open in the engine. It writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.

commands.rationale: Unfreeze (O-I #849 round 22; DLW build ruling 2026-11-05: Unfreeze returns the part to its live Torus): the takes the host froze on the part are let go from the engine's next block, and the part's chain is heard again; answered with the registry of frozen takes. Refused in words for a track that is no part and while no set is open in the engine. It writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine), O-I #849; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12

commands.rationale: A sealed Torus take played beside its part's Torus while its scene plays, or let go (O-I #855 round 25; DLW build ruling 2026-11-05: native candidate, through the engine as a take player on the Torus part, mixed beside the live Torus; the take is source material and plays through the part's current chain): the take's sound as its owner rendered it, sent raw by the page (oi.take-play/v1, verified by the page against the take's sealed pcm_sha256, from the frame it plays from, heard when the page names it), added to what the part's Torus makes in the engine from the frame heard then, through the Torus's effects as they stand and the part's own chain, volume, pan and sends; it gives way to the take played there before, and let go the part's Torus sounds alone from the next block. The host keeps each take played, which Export Audio plays again. Refused in words for another set than the one open, another rate than the engine's, a track that is no MIDI part, a take ended by the time it is heard, and while no set is open in the engine. It writes nothing. Candidate webviews only.
commands.spec_ref: ProjectCentral/docs/1-vision/dlw/DLW.md §21.1 (Rules: every part sounds in one engine; Export Audio renders what you heard), §20.1 (take lanes), O-I #855; docs/cradle/02-ARCHITECTURE.md §5/§12
